posts.title: Joseph's Temptation: How to Stand Your Ground
posts.quote: Some situations are not for debate. Just run.
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is; no custom overlay beats added this run.

captions.instagram:
Some situations don't need a better argument. You just need to leave.

Joseph was put in a situation where he knew staying around would make things harder. He didn't hang around trying to prove how strong he was. He got out.

That's the simple lesson Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo draws out in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation: sometimes the smartest response to temptation is to create distance between you and it.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#Temptation #LifeChoices #Faith #Christianity #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
Not every temptation needs a debate.

Joseph didn't stay around trying to win an argument with temptation. He left.

Sometimes that's the move. Get out of the situation before it gets harder to say no.

From Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo's sermon Resisting and Overcoming Temptation.

For the full message, search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.
captions.facebook:
Have you ever stayed in a situation longer than you knew you should?

In the story of Joseph, he faced a clear temptation. He could have stayed, talked, reasoned or tried to manage the situation.

Instead, he ran.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo uses that moment in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation to make a very practical point: there are times when resisting isn't about having the perfect argument. It's about knowing when to leave.

posts.title: Bible Commitment: Daniel's Righteousness Strategy Revealed
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is.

captions.instagram:
What you do before the pressure comes matters.

Daniel didn't suddenly start praying when his life got difficult. It was already part of his normal routine. So when the pressure came, he didn't need to invent a new response.

That's one of the practical lessons Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo draws out in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation. What you practise on ordinary days can help shape what you do on difficult ones.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#Habits #Faith #LifeChoices #Christianity #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
The middle of a crisis is a hard time to build a new habit.

Daniel kept praying under pressure because prayer wasn't something he had just started. It was already part of his life.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo unpacks this in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation.

For the full message, search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.
captions.facebook:
What happens when pressure arrives and you don't have time to work out what to do?

Daniel had already built his answer into his everyday life. Prayer was his normal routine long before it became dangerous. When the situation changed, his habit didn't.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explores this in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation and shows why what we build before a difficult moment can matter so much when it arrives.

posts.title: Jesus' Temptation: The Devil's Challenge & Divine Reply
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is.

captions.instagram:
Just because someone quotes the Bible doesn't automatically mean they're right.

When Jesus was tempted, the devil used real scripture. The words weren't made up. The problem was how they were being used.

In Resisting and Overcoming Temptation, Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo shows why one verse pulled away from the bigger picture can give you a very different message.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#Bible #Faith #Christianity #ThinkDeeper #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
Here's something you might not expect: the devil quoted scripture too.

There's an interesting moment in the temptation of Jesus. The devil actually quotes scripture. The words are genuine, but they're being used to push Jesus towards the wrong conclusion.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explores this in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation and explains why understanding the bigger picture matters.

posts.title: Devil's Power: Temptation vs. Coercion Explained
posts.quote: He can't make you. He can only offer.
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is.

captions.instagram:
Temptation can feel powerful. But an offer isn't the same as being forced.

Something can be put in front of you. You can feel the pull towards it. But there's still a choice to make.

That's actually good news.

In Resisting and Overcoming Temptation, Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explains why you may have more control in that moment than it feels like you do.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#Temptation #Choices #Faith #Christianity #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
"The devil made me do it."

But can temptation actually make you do anything?

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo makes a simple distinction: temptation can offer. It can't force.

That's an important part of Resisting and Overcoming Temptation.

For the full message, search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.
captions.facebook:
Sometimes temptation can feel so strong that saying "I had no choice" seems completely reasonable.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo challenges that idea in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation. Temptation can put something attractive in front of you, but it can't make the decision for you.

That isn't meant to pile on guilt. It's a reminder that you still have a choice, even when the pull feels strong.

Watch the full sermon by searching YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

youtube_shorts.description:

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explains why in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation.

posts.title: Run From Lust, Pursue Righteousness: 2 Timothy 2:22
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is.

captions.instagram:
Walking away is only half the job.

If you're trying to leave an old pattern behind, the question isn't only, "What am I stopping?" It's also, "What am I moving towards?"

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo makes that distinction in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation. Running from something can create the space you need, but what you put in that space matters too.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#LifeChoices #Habits #Faith #Christianity #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
Stopping something isn't always enough.

If all your attention is on what you're trying to avoid, what happens to the space it leaves behind?

In Resisting and Overcoming Temptation, Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explains the other half: don't only run away. Know what you're running towards.

captions.facebook:

Maybe the missing piece wasn't just walking away. It was deciding what would take its place.

In Resisting and Overcoming Temptation, Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo explains the instruction to flee and pursue. There is something to leave behind, but there is also something better to move towards.

posts.title: Resist Temptation: Your Path to Victory
posts.quote: God won't let it be more than you can bear.
posts.onscreen: OpusClip's own baked-in word captions used as-is.

captions.instagram:
What if the fight isn't as one-sided as it feels?

Temptation can feel overwhelming in the moment. But Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo uses a boxing analogy: you haven't been put into the ring against something completely outside your weight class.

In Resisting and Overcoming Temptation, he explains the promise that temptation won't be more than you can bear, and there will be a way out.

Watch the full sermon. Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah.

#Temptation #Hope #Faith #Christianity #CalvaryHephzibah
captions.tiktok:
Imagine being put into a boxing match against someone three weight classes above you.

Pastor Gbenga Adebanjo's point is that temptation doesn't work like that. However difficult the moment feels, you're not in an impossible mismatch.

Hear the full explanation in Resisting and Overcoming Temptation.

Search YouTube Calvary Hephzibah for the full sermon.
